summary: Refined the recovery-authority question by source reading before building its probe, and promoted two behaviors. handlePrepareReply returns on a mismatched ballot before appending the reply to lb.prepareReplies, so higher-ballot rejections never count toward SlowQuorumSize and no sub-case is dispatched at all - the recovering replica emits no PreAccept, Accept or Commit rather than restarting phase 1 with a NOOP; the only repair on that nack path (makeBallot plus a fresh bcastPrepare) is gated on r.IsLeader. Separately, makeBallot fixes a replica's recovery ballot at r.Id for the instance owner and r.Id+N otherwise, advancing only while IsLeader is true and the candidate is below maxRecvBallot, with epaxos.New hardcoding IsLeader false and only the master's BeTheLeader RPC setting it. The question's hypothesis and discriminator were updated to match: the probe must observe repeated identical Prepare ballots with no follow-up message, and then invoke the target's own BeTheLeader to see the ballot climb above maxRecvBallot and the sub-case dispatch run. The probe scenario is designed but not yet written and executed; the probe for the value-adoption question remains complete with its executed witness and executed control.
